items.text: I rarely leave bad reviews but holy moly this game is junk.  At face value this seems like exactly my type of game, a sandbox style shipbreaker.  The gameplay is so bad when paired with the graphics style and the pacing is all over the place.  Fantastic idea but a very very bad game.  I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.
items.text_zh: 我很少留差评，但天哪，这游戏真是垃圾。表面上看，这似乎正是我喜欢的类型，一款沙盒风格的拆船游戏。但玩法配上这种画面风格实在太糟糕了，节奏也乱七八糟。想法很棒，但游戏非常非常糟糕。我不会推荐给任何人。
